items.prompt: Create an original premium editorial illustration for Bearing, a calm national-news product, about a new U.S. jobs report showing sharply slower hiring. Wide landscape 16:9 composition intended both as a small news thumbnail and a future video opening. A single sculptural brushed-aluminum office chair and simple work desk sit within a beautifully lit abstract architectural office space; an open doorway and soft architectural shadows imply the possibility of work without depicting actual people or a real employer. Tactile concrete, satin metal, subtle paper texture, deep petrol and warm neutral tones, one calm morning light source, photographic craft and editorial restraint. The chair/desk are central and read clearly when small. Sophisticated illustrated still life, unmistakably conceptual, not a documentary photograph. No charts, numbers, arrows, logos, flags, signs, screens, words, or text. No dystopia, crisis imagery, particles, lens flares, dramatic smoke, or glossy plastic. Rich material detail, generous uncluttered space, exceptional clean geometry.
